notes: ISO 20022 camt.053.001.08 as Swiss banks send it under SPS 2022: GrpHdr with paging and AddtlInf, one Stmt with electronic and legal sequence numbers, the period as FrDtTm/ToDtTm with offsets, Acct with IBAN, Ccy, owner and servicer (BICFI), balances OPBD, CLBD and CLAV, a TxsSummry, then one Ntry per booking with <Sts><Cd>BOOK</Cd></Sts>, BookgDt/ValDt, AcctSvcrRef, a BkTxCd domain/family/sub-family, and TxDtls with Refs, the related party under Pty with a structured address, RmtInf (Ustrd, or a QRR reference under Strd) or AddtlTxInf, and AddtlNtryInf. UTF-8, LF, two-space indents. Opening = OPBD, closing = CLBD. The file name is assumed.
